describe: The image shows a weapon drawn as several separate pieces laid out side by side, like a texture atlas: a dark olive-green band across the top, a bright green rounded rectangle at lower left, a dark gunmetal grey round-ended tube and a grey block with two dark holes at bottom centre, and a green cylinder with grey rings and rust-orange parts at right. Colours are muted greens, dark grey and rust orange; lighting is dim, with the centre and green panels brighter than the dark edges. Keep every piece in place.
